explanation: Dell Magazines in New York printed it in 1979 as Number Place, from a design by Howard Garns. The Japanese publisher Nikoli named it Sudoku in the 1980s.

claims.text: The modern sudoku puzzle was first published in the United States, by Dell Magazines in 1979, under the name Number Place.
The modern sudoku was not first published in Japan, Switzerland or the United Kingdom.
Number Place is credited to Howard Garns, an American architect and puzzle maker.
The Japanese publisher Nikoli gave the puzzle the name Sudoku in the 1980s.

Nikoli gave the puzzle the name Sudoku (a Japanese phrase) in the 1980s.
